Surat and Mumbai jewellers, take note: Uday Kotak wants a panel on India's gold-import bill.

સુરત અને મુંબઈના ઝવેરીઓ માટે: ઉદય કોટકે ભારતના સોનાની આયાત પર સમિતિની માંગ કરી.

Kotak told a Delhi conference 19 September gold alone erased India's FY26 current account surplus: "Excluding gold, India would have recorded a current account surplus."

FY27's gold bill may hit $90bn, from $72bn. He wants a panel to bring household gold into the formal economy.

Telegraph India, Indian Jeweller, Moneycontrol, 19 Sept 2026.
